notes: Starter pack for PRC VAT bands and enterprise income tax headline rates. 税收分类编码 codes are a sample dictionary, not rates. Reviewed on 2026-11-13 against the cited STA, gov.cn, and NPC pages. Not a filing position.

semantic_mappings.rule: Use for supplies that take the headline VAT band (currently 13%; historically 17% then 16%).
Use for supplies in the 9% statutory class (historically 11% then 10%), such as transportation, construction, and the goods listed in VAT Law Art. 10(2).
Use for supplies in the 6% statutory class (services and intangible assets other than the Art. 10(1), (2) and (5) items).
Use for the 3% simplified-method collection rate, typically for small-scale taxpayers under VAT Law Art. 11. Do not use this key for a general-method band.
Use for exports of goods and prescribed cross-border sales of services or intangible assets that are zero-rated, with credit or refund as the Law provides.
Use for supplies that VAT Law Art. 24 relieves from tax. Input VAT on that supply is not creditable.
Use for the 25% enterprise income tax that applies when no reduced EIT treatment is available.
Use for high-and-new-technology enterprises that qualify under Art. 28 para 2, at 15%.
Use for eligible small and low-profit enterprises under Art. 28 para 1, at the statutory 20% reduced rate (further temporary reliefs are not encoded).
Use for the statutory 20% rate on China-source income of a non-resident enterprise without an establishment (Art. 4 para 2). Do not encode a 10% implementing-regulation figure from this pack.
